workshop: Delta Force melee 黑伤 (GMod 3834087095, Knife_H5Z01): the unsheathed rigid world model
name: Heishang
note: The Knight's execution blade (ClassKnives.csv). A short single-edged sword, 75 cm at the project's weapon size: a 50 cm red blade (0.4 cm thick, 2.8 cm across) with a clipped point on its spine side, a 7.6 cm guard, a 14 cm handle and a crested pommel. The model's handle runs along its own Z with the blade at -Z and the edge on +Y, so tip [0,0,-1] and up (the spine) [0,-1,0]; the origin is the middle of the handle, where the fist closes. Markers: Tip (the point), Edge (mid-blade on the cutting edge), Pommel (the handle's end).
